chunks: Who does greater wrong than he who tells a lie against God, and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there no place for unbelievers in Hell?
ai.seo_question: Who is considered the most unjust person according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the gravity of *al-kadhib 'ala Allah* (lying about God), often linked to the Prophets and Imams, as the quintessential form of disbelief. It serves as a stern warning that rejecting the truth upon its arrival constitutes a deliberate choice, thereby justifying Hell as the permanent abode for the disbelievers.
